title: Assistant Electrician
description:
Summary
The Assistant Electrician supports electricians in installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical systems. They assist with electrical tasks and learn the necessary skills and knowledge to become a qualified electrician.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in installing electrical systems, wiring, and components.
Inspect and test electrical equipment and systems.
Repair or replace faulty wiring and electrical parts.
Follow safety procedures and guidelines to prevent accidents.
Learn and apply electrical codes and regulations.
Maintain tools, equipment, and a clean work area.
Collaborate with experienced electricians on projects.
Job Requirements
Proven experience as an Electrician or similar role.
Relevant electrical certification or license.
Strong work ethic and commitment to safety.
Good physical fitness and manual dexterity.
Effective communication skills and the ability to follow instructions.
Enrollment in or completion of an electrical apprenticeship program (if available).
